name: Jamarion Davis
strengths: Davis mirrors in coverage with fluid hips and stays attached on the boundary.
Davis finishes as a willing tackler from the backend — not just a cover corner.
Davis shows ATH versatility (WR/CB/S) that translates to multi-spot DB packages.
weaknesses: Davis (6-0 / 175) still needs mass and length consistency to survive SEC press-man every down.
comparison: Davis comps to Derek Stingley Jr. — 6-0 lean CB mold; mirrors in coverage, finishes as a tackler, and brings ATH versatility from the boundary.
projection: Davis projects as a Year 2 DB contributor (nickel/special teams Year 1). Ceiling: starting boundary CB — the Columbia ATH who can cover, tackle, and grow into an SEC defensive back.
schemeFit: Davis fits a DB room that values mirror ability, tackle finish, and ATH flexibility across CB/nickel.
